Theme

Latin word

partēs

partēs, partium f. pl.

noun, third declension, plural

a party, a side in politics; one’s part, role, function; a part, a role (of an actor)

In this lexicon

  • party

    the recommended word · classical · Pollio in Cic. Fam. 10.31.2: nūllīus partis esse; Traupman 179, 356; M-O s.v. political party, citing Egger

  • role

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 11.5.3: tuum est hoc mūnus, tuae partēs; Cic. de Or. 2.26: Antōniī audiō esse partēs, ut dē tōtā ēloquentiā disserat (Lewis & Short)

  • role

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Phorm. 27: prīmās partēs quī aget, is erit Phormiō

  • in duās partēs secāre: halve

    our formation

  • partēs habēre (+ gen.): shareholder

    classical

  • partēs programmātiōnis: software

    modern

Examples

  • cum vērō nōn licēret mihi nūllīus partis esse, quia utrubīque magnōs inimīcōs habēbam

    since I could not stay out of both parties, having powerful enemies on each sidePollio in Cic. Fam. 10.31.2

    In the entry for party
